```{r, include = FALSE}
# Console colour carries no meaning on a rendered page. pkgdown turns it on for
# its own build, and the escape sequences then reach the reader as literal text,

```

The guides and the function reference pages cite published work throughout, and
this page carries the full entries so that every citation on the site resolves.
Each guide also lists the works it cites at its own foot, and this page gathers
those lists together with the works cited only in the function documentation and
in the design configurations that ship with the package. Every entry carries a
DOI wherever the work has one, and any work cited on both sites reads the same
here as on the [Python twin's reference
page](https://pablobernabeu.github.io/lexsync/python/references/). The
lexical corpora that lexsync reads are attributed separately, in
[`corpora/ATTRIBUTION.md`](https://github.com/pablobernabeu/lexsync/blob/main/corpora/ATTRIBUTION.md)
and in the corpus registry, since their licences travel with the derived data
rather than with the software.
